_comment: THE shipping contract for A&B Motors. One file decides four things that used to be
spelled out separately and were free to disagree: what checkout charges (delivery
profiles, scripts/setup_shipping.py), what the product page warns (the ship:* tag on
the product), which parts fall in which group, and who closes an invoiced order out.
CoreYard reads this through STORE_SHIPPING_POLICY_FILE and applies each part's tag
during the publish that creates the product — so a part is never live and sellable
wearing the wrong shipping, or none. It understands the schema generically; it knows
nothing about A&B.
A pattern is matched against BOTH the yard's own part-type spelling and the product
type it publishes as, because setup_shipping.py's fallback only ever sees the second.
So 'engine assembly' is listed beside 'engine motor assembly'.
Groups are tried in 'match_order', first substring hit wins, case-insensitive against
the part type. So a specific pattern must come before a general one. GROUND carries
"default": true and catches everything unmatched.
'rate_name' is what a shopper sees the rate called at checkout; it defaults to
'Flat Rate Freight'. A parcel group must set it — calling a $34.99 UPS Ground
rate 'freight' tells the buyer to expect a truck and a forklift.
'fulfillment' says who ships it: 'external' means ShipStation buys the label and will
close the fulfillment order itself, so `coreyard orders sync-status` must NOT fulfill
it early or the buyer loses their tracking email. 'yard' means nobody else ever will.
Keep the freight lists tight — a freight charge on a part that could have gone ground
loses the sale outright.
The seven GROUND9..GROUND44 parcel tiers carry the per-part-type UPS Ground fees
measured from historical carrier charges (see notes/, 'Shipping Costs by Hollander
Part Number', 2026-09-02). Each pattern is the yard's own part-type description or the
renderer's expansion of it. Part types with no measured fee stay in GROUND (free).
CHANGING A TAG REPUBLISHES THE PARTS IT COVERS: the tag is part of the rendered
product, so the sync sees them as changed. Run `bin/coreyard repair tags --dry-run`
first. After changing rates or patterns, re-run scripts/setup_shipping.py --apply so
the delivery profiles still agree, and scripts/check_contracts.py to confirm the theme
still matches.

PICKUP.label: Pickup only
PICKUP.note: Body panels and glass. We do not ship these at any price — they arrive damaged and cost more to crate than they are worth. Local pickup at the yard only.

A.label: Freight — oversize
A.note: Engines, transmissions, axles, and K-frames. Ships by LTL freight to a commercial address.

B.label: Freight — heavy
B.note: Transfer cases and differential carriers. Ships by LTL freight to a commercial address.

GROUND44.label: UPS Ground — $44.99
GROUND44.note: Steering racks and gearboxes. Ships UPS Ground for a flat $44.99 anywhere in the lower 48. Goes to a house like any parcel — no commercial address, no forklift. Free pickup at the yard.

GROUND34.label: UPS Ground — $34.99
GROUND34.note: Rear drive shafts, fuel filler necks and quarter-window regulators. Ships UPS Ground for a flat $34.99 anywhere in the lower 48. Goes to a house like any parcel — no commercial address, no forklift. Free pickup at the yard.

GROUND29.label: UPS Ground — $29.99
GROUND29.note: Steering columns. Ships UPS Ground for a flat $29.99 anywhere in the lower 48. Goes to a house like any parcel — no commercial address, no forklift. Free pickup at the yard.

GROUND24.label: UPS Ground — $24.99
GROUND24.note: Wheels, air cleaner boxes, radiators, struts, front lower control arms and rear knuckles. Ships UPS Ground for a flat $24.99 anywhere in the lower 48. Goes to a house like any parcel — no commercial address, no forklift. Free pickup at the yard.

GROUND19.label: UPS Ground — $19.99
GROUND19.note: Headlamps, tail lamps, glove boxes, front consoles, front spindle knuckles, AC condensers, radiator/condenser fan motors and wheel covers. Ships UPS Ground for a flat $19.99 anywhere in the lower 48. Goes to a house like any parcel — no commercial address, no forklift. Free pickup at the yard.

GROUND14.label: UPS Ground — $14.99
GROUND14.note: Smaller mechanical and electrical parts — mirrors, window regulators, alternators, starters, radios, pumps, boosters, ABS units, AC compressors, gauges and reservoirs. Ships UPS Ground for a flat $14.99 anywhere in the lower 48. Goes to a house like any parcel — no commercial address, no forklift. Free pickup at the yard.

GROUND9.label: UPS Ground — $9.99
GROUND9.note: Small light parts — fuel filler doors, interior mirrors, sun visors, master cylinders, control modules, cabin fuse boxes, front door switches and climate controls. Ships UPS Ground for a flat $9.99 anywhere in the lower 48. Goes to a house like any parcel — no commercial address, no forklift. Free pickup at the yard.

GROUND.label: Free ground
GROUND.note: Ships free anywhere in the lower 48, with UPS calculated offered as a paid option. Free local delivery around Amite.
